groups.name: Capitals on the Danube
groups.fact: The Danube flows through four national capitals, more than any other river in the world.

groups.name: Capitals on the Baltic Sea
groups.fact: Helsinki and Tallinn face each other across the Gulf of Finland, only about 80 km apart.

groups.name: Capitals on the Pacific coast
groups.fact: Panama City sits at the Pacific end of the Panama Canal.

groups.name: Capitals on the Atlantic coast
groups.fact: Pointe des Almadies, in Dakar, is the westernmost point of mainland Africa.
